visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A line of diverse cats including calico, orange, and grey breeds are hunched over, eating simultaneously from silver metal bowls on a light-colored wooden floor. In the background, patrons are seated on a plush green banquette in a brightly lit indoor space. Large pink text with a white border is centered on the screen. (2) A close-up shows a human hand gently stroking a tan-colored cat lying by a large glass window. A young girl with dark hair wearing denim overalls is crouched nearby, watching the cat intently. The window features white frosted decals of a fish and a paw print. (3) A baby boy in a blue patterned shirt is sitting on the floor, curiously looking at a cat near a white Panasonic air purifier. The camera angle is low to the ground, capturing the interaction at the child's eye level. (4) A woman wearing a black t-shirt and the young girl in overalls stand side-by-side in front of a pink accent wall. They wave cheerfully at the camera. Above them is a large white and purple logo of a cat's head inside a paw shape with text identifying the venue. (5) A top-down shot focuses on a person's legs in lavender pants and feet wearing dark grey protective shoe covers, standing on the wooden floor. (6) A wall with circular photo displays features individual portraits of various cats, each with their name and birth information in Chinese. The wall is soft pink, and a 'RULALA' brand sign is visible at the top. (7) Several quick shots follow: a hand petting a fluffy grey cat, a black and white cat grooming itself inside a white circular cubby in a cat tree, and a wide shot of the cafe interior showing a hand-drawn mural of a city and houses on the far wall. (8) The woman is seen sitting on the floor with the baby, interacting with the environment while other patrons sit at low round tables in the background. The space is wide and well-lit with recessed ceiling lights. (9) A display case is filled with an assortment of desserts, including green matcha mille-crepe cakes, fruit tarts, and small glass bottles of juice. Small price tags are placed in front of each item. (10) Extreme close-up shots highlight specialized food items: a tiramisu with a pink cat-shaped topper, macarons decorated with pink paw prints, and iced lattes with cat-shaped silver stirrers. (11) The final sequence shows a wide view of the cafe with guests relaxing, followed by a close-up of a cream-colored cat sleeping peacefully in a patch of bright sunlight on a white surface.
